coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the character box. Box glyph: the character box.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and thin filled rectangles; both pages looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: The subscriber completes and signs the signature page (page 2); joint owners are told to sign "above" but only one signature line is printed; the company accepts at the foot of page 2.

sure_per_page.1: sure (no place for the subscriber; the one prose blank is the company's)
sure_per_page.2: sure; two judgements: the prospectus-date blank in the first sentence is the company's (not a place), and the "Other ____ #" blank is its own place

1: "120 days from ________, 201_" in the payment instructions: a date in the prose the company sets (the closing reference date), not a place for the subscriber
heading underlines (A. Instructions, B. Communications, the underlined payee name) and the footer rule (y 664)
the stray underscore in the EX-3.3 header line
2: "dated on or around _________________, 201_" in the opening sentence: the date of the prospectus, which the company completes, not the subscriber
"(circle one) Social Security # - Passport # - Drivers' License # - Tax ID #": printed words to circle, no box
heading underlines (y 74, 410, 494) and the footer rule (y 616)
